endpoints.description: Canonical decode of a stash payload (the fragment value from a share URL, everything after #p= or #q=). Content negotiation via Accept: application/json, text/markdown, or text/plain; fallback ?format=json|md|txt.
OpenAPI 3.1 specification of all Stash HTTP endpoints (viewer decode, shortener, profile-local browser-agent surface).
LLM-oriented documentation for agents consuming Stash.

servers.name: stash-shortener
servers.description: Hosted MCP server for creating and resolving short stash links.

tools.name: stash_create
tools.description: Create a stash: a short shareable link bundling multiple URLs. Returns the short id and share URL.

tools.name: stash_get
tools.description: Fetch a stash by its short id and return its title and items.

tools.name: stash_decode
tools.description: Decode a stash payload string (the ?p= value from a stash share URL) into its title and items.

servers.name: stash-extension
servers.description: Browser extension MCP surface over a Chrome runtime port (no HTTP). Exposes the local stash library and current tabs.

tools.name: stash_snapshot_tabs
tools.description: Read-only snapshot of the tabs currently open in this browser window (url + title).

tools.name: stash_list
tools.description: List local stashes (id, title, tags, item counts, timestamps).

tools.name: stash_get
tools.description: Fetch a local stash by id, including its full item list.

tools.name: stash_create
tools.description: Create and persist a new local stash from a list of URLs (with optional titles), title, tags and note.

tools.name: stash_update
tools.description: Update an existing local stash's title, items, tags or note.

tools.name: stash_delete
tools.description: Delete a local stash by id.

tools.name: stash_search
tools.description: Search local stashes by free-text query across titles, urls and notes.

tools.name: stash_decode
tools.description: Decode a stash payload string into its title and items without persisting.
